question: Let $A$ and $C$ be two distinct points in the plane and $B$ a point on the line segment $AC$ such that $AB=2BC$. Then the locus of the point $P$ lying in the plane and satisfying the condition $AP^2+CP^2=2BP^2$ is

options.A: a straight line parallel to the line $AC$
options.B: a straight line perpendicular to the line $AC$

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
